item.title: Scoring timing windows for in-water work
item.description: Dredging, shoreline construction, culvert replacement, dam removal, reef building: in-water work cannot always be avoided, but its timing can usually be chosen to minimize the impacts it will have on wildlife. This is usually achieved through the identification of optimal timing windows for in-water work. They set the periods when work may proceed around the fish it could harm, or the restricted periods when it may not, so that life cycles crucial for the health of populations, such as spawning, migration, and rearing, are avoided.
